scores.evidence: No hard failures in metrics.json (overflowX false, 0 console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors). The s3-diagram flowchart TD has readable Japanese labels at 390 px (mobile-jp-10/11), and the tables and code read cleanly on desktop. On mobile, lines 6 and 8 of the practice-answer code reach the right edge, and the end of line 8 is cut off (mobile-jp-25).

No text-only screens on either device (textOnlyScreens is empty). Each section mixes definitions, a table or code with an inline check, so there are no walls of text. Desktop charsPerLine has a median of 42 (34–50), above the JP target of 30–40. The practice section is long on mobile (about 9 screens, mobile-jp-18 to 26), but steps and code break it up.

This is a Japanese-only lesson, and no stray English UI shows on the JP screens. Contrast is fine throughout, and no controls are hidden under the top or bottom bars. In the s1-table on mobile, the row label 「組織の全員」 breaks inside the word as 「組織の全／員」 (mobile-jp-04).

mustFix.issue: At 390 px the model-answer code lines are wider than the code block. Line 8 「- コミットの前に `npm run test:unit` を通す」 is cut off after 「を通」. Lines 6 (「…で実行する」) and 19 (「…入力を検証してから使う」) run to the very edge, and nothing tells the learner the block scrolls.
mustFix.fix: Keep each line within about 34 full-width columns, as already done for lines 6–7. For example, split line 8 into 「- コミットの前に」 and 「  `npm run test:unit` を通す」. Shorten line 6 to 「- テストは `npm run test:unit`」. Change line 19 to 「- 入力を検証してから使う」 (the file already applies only to src/api/). Then update `highlight` to match the new line numbers.

mustFix.issue: In the narrow first column on mobile, the row label 「組織の全員」 wraps inside the word as 「組織の全／員」.
mustFix.fix: Shorten the label so it fits on one line in the 届く範囲 column, for example 「組織全体」 or 「組織」 (the other labels are 「自分」 and 「チーム」).

niceToHave: The step titles in s5-steps and practice-steps start with ①–⑥, but the reader already shows a numbered circle next to each step, so each number appears twice (mobile-jp-16, desktop-jp-11). Removing the circled numbers from the titles would declutter them.
In practice-hint3 on mobile, the inline code `docs/add-screen.md` wraps at the hyphen (「docs/add-」/「screen.md」, mobile-jp-24). Moving it to the start of a sentence would help it stay on one line.
Several practice-checklist labels on mobile wrap awkwardly around inline paths, for example 「好みはCLAUDE.local.mdにあ／り」 (mobile-jp-23). Shorter labels or a different word order would avoid this.
The practice-prompt shows literal backticks around paths (`.claude/settings.json`). This is acceptable for text to paste, but plain quotes would read more cleanly (desktop-jp-15).

summary: The screenshots match lessonHash sha256:a2581804ebc9fe6d, there are no hard failures in metrics.json, and no personal data appears on any screen. The layout is clean and varied: every section has a table, definitions, code or a diagram plus an inline check, and the TD flowchart is readable at 390 px. The most important fix is the practice-answer code block, whose longest Japanese lines are cut off on mobile; the other is the 「組織の全員」 label in s1-table, which breaks mid-word.
